description: Source code for a Slate.js-based rich text editor schema and initialization, including schema definitions, normalization, and editor creation functions.

methods.name: inlineContainer
methods.description: Creates an inline container schema with specified invalid position handling mode.

methods.name: createDocumentEditor
methods.description: Constructs a Slate editor with a complex chain of plugins and normalization, configured with document features, component blocks, and relationships.

methods.name: blockContainer
methods.description: Creates a block container schema with specified allowed children and invalid position handling mode.

methods.name: isInlineContainer
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is an inline container based on its type.

methods.name: withBlocksSchema
methods.description: Enhances an editor with schema normalization logic for block and inline nodes.

methods.name: handleNodeInInvalidPosition
methods.description: Handles nodes found in invalid positions during normalization, either unwrapping or moving them.
